summary: The Fairbanks court opened seven new criminal cases on Nov. 16 and 17, two of them on felony assault counts. In one, a firearm assault count against Jerald Curtis Waters was dismissed by the prosecutor the day it was filed; the other, against Andre Lee Rue, also charges him with drunk driving and leaving the scene of an injury crash. Troopers are asking for help finding Megan Baldwin, 33, of North Pole, reported missing Nov. 16, and arrested a man wanted on two felony warrants after he fled a stop on South Cushman Street. The state court's closed-cases report shows 18 Interior cases closed Nov. 10 to 13, including the dismissal of two felony counts. This edition replaces the morning file, which was compiled when none of the primary records could be read.

entries.title: Felony firearm assault charge filed and dismissed: Jerald Curtis Waters
body: Jerald Curtis Waters, 40, was arrested on a charge of assault in the third degree, placing someone in fear of serious injury with a weapon, a Class C felony. Police recorded an aggravated assault with a firearm at Cushman Street and First Avenue at 3:39 p.m. Nov. 16, and the arrest at First Avenue and Lacey Street at 3:40 p.m.; Fairbanks Police case 26003487.
The felony count was filed Nov. 17 in case 4FA-26-02301CR and dismissed by the prosecutor the same day. The case is closed and no charge stands.

entries.title: Felony assault and leaving the scene of an injury crash: Andre Lee Rue
body: Andre Lee Rue is charged with assault in the third degree, causing injury with a dangerous instrument, a Class C felony punishable by up to five years, along with driving under the influence, driving with a revoked license, driving in violation of license limits and leaving the scene of a crash involving injury.
The charges are dated Nov. 16 in Fairbanks. Case 4FA-26-02299CR; arraigned Nov. 17, preliminary hearings Nov. 25 and Dec. 7.

entries.title: Failure to stop for police: Christopher Allan Evans
body: Christopher Allan Evans, 40, of Fairbanks, is charged with failure to stop at the direction of a peace officer in the second degree, a Class A misdemeanor.

Troopers say their Criminal Suppression Unit tried to stop him on South Cushman Street Nov. 16 while he had two felony warrants, that he fled and then ran on foot into the Lakeview Terrace trailer park, and that he was found hiding behind a trailer and arrested on the warrants.
Case 4FA-26-02300CR; arraigned Nov. 17, next court date Jan. 7, 2027.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 17

entries.title: Missing person: Megan Baldwin
body: Troopers are asking for information about Megan Baldwin, 33, of North Pole, reported missing Nov. 16 after last being seen near Badger Road, Persinger Drive and Keeling Road. She was with a black pit bull mix, is about 5 feet 5 inches tall with dark hair, and her phone is disconnected.
Anyone with information should contact the Alaska State Troopers in Fairbanks.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 17

entries.title: DUI: James Sean Maska-Johnson
body: James Sean Maska-Johnson, 20, is charged with driving under the influence, a Class A misdemeanor. Fairbanks Police arrested him at Washington Drive and Airport Way at 2:21 a.m. Nov. 16. Case 4FA-26-02296CR.

entries.title: Driving in violation of an instruction permit: Sophia Christabeldell Simmonds
body: Sophia Christabeldell Simmonds, 18, is charged with driving in violation of an instruction permit, a misdemeanor. Fairbanks Police arrested her on the 1400 block of South Cushman Street at 11:30 p.m. Nov. 16. Case 4FA-26-02302CR; next court date Dec. 18.

entries.title: Criminal trespass charge filed: Timothy Royal Bidwell
body: Timothy Royal Bidwell is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree, a Class B misdemeanor, over his Nov. 15 arrest on South Cushman Street. Case 4FA-26-02297CR.

entries.title: DUI: Henry Cole Lilley
body: Henry Cole Lilley is charged with driving under the influence, a Class A misdemeanor, dated Nov. 17 in North Pole. Case 4FA-26-02298CR; arraignment Nov. 24.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Hunter Marshall Freling
body: Hunter Marshall Freling is charged with driving with a revoked license after a prior conviction, a Class A misdemeanor, dated Nov. 12 in Fairbanks. Case 4FA-26-02303CR.

entries.title: Injury collision on the Richardson Highway
body: A two-vehicle collision near Milepost 356 of the Richardson Highway at about 8:01 a.m. Nov. 17 sent a 61-year-old North Pole man to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital, troopers say. The other driver, 21, was cited for following too closely.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 17

entries.title: Court outcomes Nov. 10–13: two felony counts dismissed, Nenana DUI conviction
body: Prosecutors dismissed a third-degree sexual assault count, a Class C felony, and an assault count against Natalie Mestas on Nov. 10 (4FA-25-00635CR), and a third-degree assault count, a Class C felony, against Nicholas Edward Bell on Nov. 12 (4FA-26-02012CR).

At Nenana, Christopher Jaden Anthony Graham was convicted on guilty pleas of driving under the influence and possessing a weapon while intoxicated (4NE-25-00107CR); an assault count in a second case was dismissed under the plea agreement (4NE-25-00115CR).
Eighteen criminal cases in total were closed at the four Interior courts between Nov. 10 and Nov. 13, most by dismissal.
